item.title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen 16:9 ad for FitTrack using both screenshots. Show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name. Clean, energetic, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover. Other copy is your call.

item.tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

answer_sheet.Brand and source images: FitTrack; use app-home.png followed by app-workout.png.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Clean and energetic; other design choices are your call.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: End with FitTrack; other copy is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a polished vertical static mobile app advertisement for FitTrack using BOTH supplied app screenshots. Show two elegant smartphone mockups side by side, slightly staggered, centered in the composition: the first phone displays the supplied blue-header FitTrack home dashboard screenshot, and the second displays the supplied green-header Workout screenshot. Keep the actual screenshot content and text faithful and legible, do not invent app features or extra metrics. Clean premium fitness-tech visual design, light cool white background, blue and green accents coordinated with the screenshots, subtle rounded geometric shapes and soft realistic shadows, generous margins. At top set a large highly legible bold dark navy headline exactly: 'Your fitness. One place.' Below headline add smaller text exactly: 'Track your day. Plan your workout.' At bottom include a strong rounded blue call-to-action label exactly: 'Start tracking today'. Small FitTrack wordmark above headline. Balanced professional graphic design with strong hierarchy, crisp typography and uncluttered layout. No app store logos, no unsupported health claims, no pricing, no invented testimonials.
